text: 12.3 1 I have hundreds of friends all over the world. 2 I have friends at college that I meet up with every day. 3 I have a lot of colleagues in a big circle of acquaintances. 4 We keep in touch as much as possible. Five. Well, I'm a bit of a loner. Six. My circle of friends is quite small. Seven. I'm quite outgoing and chatty. Eight. I've also made a lot of new friends on my course.
